facts.title: Arugula & Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cubed (about 1″) pieces of seedless watermelon (from ½ of a mini watermelon, or about ¼ of a medium watermelon)
⅓ cup halved and pitted Kalamata olives
2 tablespoons sherry vinegar or red wine vinegar
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
